title: Ivy Lee method of Gets Things Done
text:
The process of Ivy Lee Method of getting things done is as follows:

At the end of day, write down 6 tasks with priority to do the next day.
Start with first task and keep working on it until finished.
Move to next task if first task is finished.
Repeat the Steps 1-3.


Spill-over of tasks to the following day is allowed.

title: Fahim Ahmed
text:
Fahim Ahmed is working as a Highway Safety Design Engineer with the South Carolina Department of Transportation (SCDOT). In his role in the Traffic Safety Office at SCDOT, he prepares Roadway Design Plans for Intersection Improvement Projects.
Fahim Ahmed is a Ph.D. candidate studying Civil Engineering (Dissertation on Transportation Engr.) at University of South Carolina. His research interest is in the topic of freight system performance, vehicle routing, and traffic safety. Currently, he is working with Dr. Nathan Huynh to develop a solution for truck (re-)routing under disruptive environment in a distribution network.
